Unhead install.description:
Install Unhead on the application. Requires createHead from @unhead/vue/client; a server build imports it from @unhead/vue/server instead.

在应用上安装 Unhead；需要 @unhead/vue/client 的 createHead，服务端构建改从 @unhead/vue/server 导入。

Unhead useHead.description:
Set the document title and meta tags for the current component. Requires useHead from @unhead/vue.

为当前组件设置文档标题与 meta 标签；需要 @unhead/vue 的 useHead。

Unhead reactive title.description:
Derive the title from state; a getter is re-evaluated whenever its source changes. Requires useHead from @unhead/vue.

由状态派生标题，getter 会随来源变化重新求值；需要 @unhead/vue 的 useHead。

Unhead title template.description:
Wrap every page title in a site-wide pattern; set it once in the root component. Requires useHead from @unhead/vue.

为每个页面标题套用站点级模板，在根组件设置一次即可；需要 @unhead/vue 的 useHead。

Unhead useSeoMeta.description:
Declare social and search metadata as flat keys instead of hand-writing meta tags. Requires useSeoMeta from @unhead/vue.

以扁平键声明社交与搜索元数据，无需手写 meta 标签；需要 @unhead/vue 的 useSeoMeta。
